project_info.theme: Quán Nhậu Tự Do DJ weekend lineup poster
project_info.color_palette: Neon green, black, bright yellow, white, skin tones, warm club highlights

main_subject.detail: High-energy nightlife event poster featuring a collage of seven DJ and performer portraits arranged in two tiers against a green concert-light background, with oversized stacked headline text announcing the weekend DJ schedule.
main_subject.style: Photorealistic entertainment poster, glossy club-event compositing, dramatic portrait retouching, neon festival atmosphere

composition_elements.text: QUÁN NHẬU TỰ DO / LỊCH DJ CUỐI TUẦN / 26 - 27/06 / MINH KHAI • NGUYỄN VĂN TUYẾT • LINH ĐÀM PHỐ ĐỨC CHÍNH • HỒNG TIẾN • PARKING ZONE 4 / 29/06 / PARKING ZONE 4 / Hotline đặt bàn: *1986
items: Top Left: Quán Nhậu Tự Do logo with yellow star and white wordmark.
Top Right: Green concert spotlights, speaker stacks, and scattered glowing particles.
Bottom Left: Rounded neon-framed date box '26 - 27/06' with venue list 'MINH KHAI • NGUYỄN VĂN TUYẾT • LINH ĐÀM PHỐ ĐỨC CHÍNH • HỒNG TIẾN • PARKING ZONE 4'.
Bottom Right: Matching neon-framed date box '29/06' with text 'PARKING ZONE 4'.
Center/Background: Giant white-and-yellow headline 'LỊCH DJ CUỐI TUẦN' behind seven performer portraits, plus orange hotline strip at the bottom reading 'Hotline đặt bàn: *1986'.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Neon green beams, crowd silhouettes, glowing edges around portraits, spark particles, intense nightlife contrast

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality advertising poster for Quán Nhậu Tự Do DJ weekend lineup poster. Centerpiece is a seven-person collage of DJs and performers layered over a neon green club background with giant stacked text 'LỊCH DJ CUỐI TUẦN'. Background is a dark concert venue scene with stage spotlights, speaker arrays, glowing haze, and crowd silhouettes. Surrounding elements: top-left Quán Nhậu Tự Do logo, left neon date panel '26 - 27/06' with venue list 'MINH KHAI • NGUYỄN VĂN TUYẾT • LINH ĐÀM PHỐ ĐỨC CHÍNH • HỒNG TIẾN • PARKING ZONE 4', right neon date panel '29/06' and 'PARKING ZONE 4', and bottom orange strip 'Hotline đặt bàn: *1986'. Technical style: photorealistic event poster compositing, concert lighting, neon green beams and spark particles, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry, flat 2d, low resolution, distorted text, messy typography, muted colors, black and white, ugly, deformed shapes, watermark, signature, cropped
